revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 11.8% (63,325 vs 56,654, 10-K 0000858877-26-000132); fade toward mature-market growth as acquisition/AI-networking tailwind normalizes.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 GAAP EBIT margin 24.3% (15,368/63,325); held roughly flat, below FY26 peak given FY24-25 margins of 22.6%/20.8%.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.95 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.1% cost of equity; beta = Damodaran Telecom Equipment cash-corrected unlevered 0.887 relevered at D/E 0.092 (Damodaran industry D/E; no share price available for Cisco market D/E), tax 21%; after-tax Kd 3.97% (Damodaran); weights 91.6/8.4 -> ~8.7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below 10Y Treasury 4.86%; mature-company rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 29,533 (LT 19,372 + current 10,161) - cash 7,218 - ST investments 8,700; 10-K 0000858877-26-000132
